text:
```yaml
name: Check Branch Alias

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-branch-alias:
    name: Check Branch Alias
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.1'
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer install --no-interaction --no-progress --no-suggest

      - name: Check branch alias in composer.json
        run: |
          # Ensure the branch alias is correctly set for the current branch
          # This is a simple check to ensure composer.json is valid and contains expected structure
          composer validate --strict
          
          # Check if branch-alias exists in extra section
          if ! grep -q '"branch-alias"' composer.json; then
            echo "::warning::No branch-alias found in composer.json. Ensure it is configured for development branches."
          fi
```
